text: Hard Rock International is owned outright by the Seminole Tribe of Florida (acquired 2007). A federally recognised tribe is not a state in this dataset's sense, and the tribe has no documented rights finding.
short: Hard Rock International is owned outright by the Seminole Tribe of Florida (acquired 2007).

source.name: Hard Rock International - corporate (Seminole Hard Rock)
source.quote: the Seminole Tribe of Florida acquired the Hard Rock brand in 2007
